summary: Audited all 26 clinical syndrome cards (src/data/syndromes/{diencephalon,hindbrain,midbrain}.json) and both directions of the artery<->syndrome links, and wrote the two deliverables docs/audit/v15/syndromes.findings.json (16 findings, fixed schema {id,area,recordId,field,claimed,expected,verdict,severity,basis,basisKind,suggestedFix,notes}) and docs/audit/v15/syndromes.md (summary tables + method + evidence). No data file was edited (read-only auditor role). FINDINGS: 14 wrong / 1 suspect / 1 unverifiable-here; 3 critical, 10 major, 3 minor; 11 of 26 cards carry a finding, 15 are clean. Three critical defects: (1) vasc-middle-cerebral-artery.supply names syn-parkinson, a card that declares itself non-vascular, so opening Parkinson's disease renders the MCA as its causal artery; (2) the same record names syn-lateral-medullary, a PICA/vertebral syndrome whose card never mentions the MCA anywhere (external basis: StatPearls Wallenberg); (3) syn-foville.presentation states the horizontal gaze palsy backwards ('the eyes deviate away' as the definition) against nuc-pprf/nuc-abducens/syn-one-and-a-half and against StatPearls Foville ('inability to move the eyes towards the affected side'). Major: syn-weber lists the medullary tract-corticospinal-lateral as a midbrain lesion structure; syn-millard-gubler asserts a nuclear/PPRF lesion the classic definition does not require; three one-sided card->artery links (PCA/syn-hypothalamic, AICA+PICA/syn-cerebellar, basilar/syn-central-horner); four artery-side records over-claim cards they cannot cause (ICA, PCoA, lenticulostriate, posterior medial choroidal); syn-hemimedullary states Horner syndrome and ataxia while listing neither tract-hypothalamospinal nor tract-icp. Minor: syn-ino lists the abducens and oculomotor nuclei as damaged rather than deafferented; a duplicate Parinaud eponym across syn-parinaud and syn-pineal-region; and one unverifiable-here row (no anterior spinal artery record exists, so syn-medial-medullary's named artery cannot be reciprocated). Also recorded as PASS so the integrator need not redo it: all 58 distinct structure ids resolve in taxonomy.json (the tract-* ids live in tracts.json, not structures/*.json, and are NOT dangling), no duplicate or near-duplicate cards, all eponyms verified as current usage. VERIFICATION: npm run validate -> PASSED 0 errors / 0 warnings; the evidence-contract node command prints findings 16 and exits 0; both files non-empty; an independent 39-check re-verification script re-derived every load-bearing claim from the untouched JSON (MCA supply contents, Foville phrase, Weber tract level, PCA/AICA/PICA/basilar supply omissions, ICA/PCoA/lenticulostriate/choroidal claims, eponym duplication, hemimedullary structures, registry ids) and all 39 pass; a final gate re-read the data after concurrent edits by other agents and confirmed 26 cards, schema completeness and the card census (15 clean + 11 flagged = 26). Chrome-dependent gates (verify:acceptance, verify:audit) were not claimed, and no finding asks for a mesh, bbox, origin3d/size3d or level change.
